title: Neural-field comets with synaptic depression: from noise, a gas of 30-40 self-propelled comets that travel up to 40-58 body lengths and multiply by break-up of elongated comets, where the depression-free twin makes spiral waves (SIMD, L6[L2])
summary: c20's neural-field comets (sighting 20261025T1707-c20-neural-field-comets) at a lower firing threshold (theta 0.4) with Tsodyks-Markram-type synaptic depression: the coupling acts on r f(u), and firing depletes r, which recovers on time 50. From correlated noise over the whole domain, 3/3 seeds settle by t~40 into 30-40 discrete comets (active head, adaptation wake; 14-60 px) that travel up to 40.8, 47.2 and 58.0 body lengths; comets elongate into crescents and bars that break into comets, and collisions merge or annihilate them, so the count stays at 30-40 to t=1000 with turnover (labkit: 29/27/25 persistent splits, generation 6/6/4, merge/split 0.26-0.29). A lone comet with depression multiplies into ~40 comets by t~400 (lone_comet_proliferates.png), while without depression it stays one bump (theta 0.5) or grows into domain-wide waves (theta <= 0.485; finding 20261025T1713). The twin with depression off (kd=0) at the same theta makes spiral waves and labyrinths, with no persistent splits and occupancy 0.31. dt/2: 25 persistent splits, generation 6, 29 final comets.

claims.statement: On 3/3 seeds (128^2, L=64, T=1000) a neural field started from noise over the whole domain forms 30-40 discrete comets of bounded size (persistent-track max/min area 5.4-8.8) that move by their own activity-adaptation asymmetry up to 40.8/47.2/58.0 body lengths, and that multiply: elongated comets break into comets (29/27/25 persistent splits, generation 6/6/4, merge/split 0.26/0.27/0.29), balancing collision losses so that the population stays at 30-40 with turnover.
claims.track: seed 0, labkit track 433 (pack/seed0/metrics.json top_tracks and motion_top): born at frame 95 by a split of track 423, travels 32.1 body lengths as a comet, and divides persistently at frame 171 into tracks 591 and 594

controls_run.D: pack_kd0/seed0, seed1 (synaptic depression off, same theta): spiral waves and labyrinths, 0 persistent splits, occupancy 0.31-0.32
controls_run.numerics: pack_dt2 (dt 0.05, seed 0): 25 persistent splits, generation 6, 29 final comets, 31 body lengths max

claims.bd_control: none: the operator is a nonlocal integral kernel (balanced difference of Gaussians, zero integral); its Laplacian truncation has a negative second moment and is ill-posed (anti-diffusion), so no matched Laplacian-only twin is defined

limits: Individuals are L2: a comet is an activity pulse with an adaptation wake, not a bounded material body; there is no conserved matter. Division is break-up of elongated comets in a dense gas, so many births follow collisions, and the strips are crowded; the fission is not a size-controlled cycle of a lone comet (a lone comet first grows into arcs and rings before it breaks up). Travelling neural-field bumps and depression-driven pulses are known (Coombes, Kilpatrick and Bressloff), so novelty is moderate. One kernel and one adaptation setting; no resolution test.
